subject: Logic
title: Irrational Root of Two
description: Learn Irrational Root of Two in one minute.

hook.text: The ancient Greeks believed every length could be expressed as a ratio of whole numbers. Then someone checked √2.

buildup.text: Assume √2 = a/b in lowest terms. Square both sides: 2 = a²/b². So a² = 2b²—meaning a is even.

discovery.text: If a is even, write a = 2k. Then 4k² = 2b², so b² = 2k²—meaning b is even too. But we said lowest terms.

twist.text: Contradiction. √2 can never be a ratio of whole numbers. An entirely new kind of number had been discovered.

climax.text: Legend says the Pythagorean who proved this was drowned at sea. The truth was too dangerous for the cult.

punchline.text: Some numbers refuse to be fractions.

quiz.question: What did proving √2 is irrational reveal?
options: Some numbers cannot be expressed as fractions
